steadyPrecession.vectorInsight: Gravity pulls down — but τ = dL/dt is ⊥ L, so the tip moves sideways.
steadyPrecession.noTorqueMessage: Pivot at center of mass: τ = 0, no precession.
steadyPrecession.formulaHint: Ω = τ / (I ω)  —  faster spin → slower precession

nutation.placeholder: Nutation screen — release from a tilted angle to see wobble on top of steady precession. Coming soon.

torqueFree.placeholder: Torque-free tumbling — asymmetric rigid body via Euler's equations. Coming soon.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a spinning gyroscope on a pivoted axle, a live vector diagram of weight, torque, angular momentum, and precession, and a graph of precession angle versus time.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you change spin rate, arm mass, pivot distance, and whether the pivot is at the center of mass. Numeric readouts compare measured and predicted precession rates.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Adjust the spin rate and arm mass, then watch how the precession rate responds. Toggle pivot at center of mass to see precession stop.

steadyPrecession.currentDetailsPattern: Predicted precession rate is {{predictedHz}} hertz. Measured slope is {{measuredHz}} hertz.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area will show nutation — wobble on top of steady precession when the top is released off-equilibrium.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls for initial tilt and nutation kick will appear here.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area will show a torque-free asymmetric rigid body tumbling in space, with the Poinsot construction on the inertia ellipsoid.
